description: Source code implementing MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) based linear operations for PyTorch, including forward and backward passes, with device-specific optimizations for Apple Silicon hardware.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure holding references to MPSGraph tensors to optimize repeated graph execution during linear operations.

methods.name: _mps_linear_nograph
methods.description: Performs MPS-based linear operation without creating a computation graph, directly encoding commands.

methods.name: _mps_linear
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of a linear transformation using MPS, with device-specific optimization.

methods.name: _mps_linear_backward_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the input tensor during backward pass using MPS.

methods.name: _mps_linear_backward_weights
methods.description: Computes the gradients of weights and bias tensors during backward pass using MPS.

methods.name: mps_linear_backward
methods.description: Wrapper function to compute gradients for input, weights, and bias tensors during backward pass.
